title: The inconvenient truth of problemistic search: real earnings management
title_zh: 问题搜索的不便真相：真实盈余管理
authors: Juil Lee, Sang-Joon Kim, Kyung Min Park
abstract: This study examines how negative performance feedback is associated with real earnings management (REM) and how firm-level market power conditions that relationship. Building on the behavioural theory of the firm and threat-rigidity theory, we argue that performance shortfalls direct organizational attention towards responses that are immediate, proximate, and risk-acceptable. REM fits this behavioural profile because it can alter reported outcomes through real operating decisions while remaining less directly visible than many accounting choices or illegal actions. Using 23,629 firm-year observations for publicly listed U.S. firms from 1992 to 2018, we find that larger performance shortfalls are associated with higher REM. We also find that this relationship weakens as market power increases. Additional analyses support a cautious interpretation: the evidence is more consistent with shortfall-driven opportunistic REM than with a purely strategic or efficiency-enhancing explanation, although standard REM proxies do not directly identify managerial intent. The findings contribute to applied research on firm behaviour under performance pressure by showing that market power can alter the way firms respond to adverse feedback through real operating decisions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了负面绩效反馈如何影响真实盈余管理（REM），以及企业层面的市场势力如何调节这一关系。基于企业行为理论与威胁-刚性理论，我们提出：绩效缺口会将组织注意力导向即时、直接且风险可接受的应对措施。真实盈余管理符合这一行为特征——它通过实际经营决策改变报告业绩，同时相较于诸多会计选择或违法行为具有更低的直接可见性。基于1992年至2018年间美国上市公司23,629个公司-年度观测值，本研究发现：绩效缺口越大，真实盈余管理程度越高；市场势力越强，该正向关联越弱。进一步分析支持审慎解读：证据更倾向于表明绩效缺口驱动机会主义型真实盈余管理，而非纯粹战略或效率提升型解释——尽管标准真实盈余管理代理变量无法直接识别管理层意图。本研究通过揭示市场势力如何改变企业通过实际经营决策应对负面反馈的方式，为绩效压力下企业行为的应用研究提供了新见解。

title: Making connections: access and market competition with public broadband
title_zh: 建立连接：公共宽带接入与市场竞争
authors: Mark F. Owens, Adam D. Rennhoff
abstract: We use causal forests to examine how public utility broadband providers are associated with broadband adoption and local market structure across 194 counties in Tennessee and Iowa, 38 of which have a public utility broadband provider. Public provider presence is associated with an average 6% point higher broadband adoption share, lower private-carrier market shares, and lower measured market concentration, though the latter partly reflects the mechanical effect of an additional provider on the concentration index. The estimated adoption difference is largest in lower-income and urban counties and in counties where public providers have greater geographic reach and offer lower prices. Given the cross-sectional design, limited number of treated counties, and the observable income imbalance between treated and untreated counties, we interpret these results as a transparent, explicitly associational account of structured heterogeneity in broadband outcomes rather than as causal estimates; sensitivity analyses indicate that the income heterogeneity patterns are not driven solely by the observable selection margin.
abstract_zh: 我们采用因果森林方法，考察公共事业宽带提供商如何与田纳西州和爱荷华州194个县的宽带普及率及本地市场结构相关联，其中38个县拥有公共事业宽带提供商。公共提供商的存在与宽带普及率平均高出6个百分点、私营运营商市场份额降低以及市场集中度下降相关——尽管后者部分反映了新增提供商对集中度指数的机械性影响。宽带普及率差异在低收入县、城市县以及公共提供商地理覆盖范围更广、定价更低的县中最为显著。鉴于本研究采用横截面设计、受处理县数量有限，且受处理县与未受处理县之间存在可观测的收入不平衡，我们将这些结果解读为对宽带结果中结构化异质性的透明、明确关联性描述，而非因果估计；敏感性分析表明，收入异质性模式并非仅由可观测的选择性边界驱动。

title: When Competition Needs Awareness: Regulating Social Media with Naive Users
title_zh: 当竞争需要意识：对具有天真用户的社交媒体进行监管
authors: Martino Banchio, Francesco Decarolis, Carl-Christian Groh, Rafael Jiménez-Durán, Miguel Risco, Martino Banchio; Francesco Decarolis; Carl-Christian Groh; Rafael Jiménez-Durán; Miguel Risco
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Can intensifying competition protect social media users? The answer depends on users’ awareness of the harms of social media content. We develop a model of asymmetric competition between platforms with naive users, in which platforms choose how much to amplify harmful yet engaging content. Naive users do not internalize the adverse effects of consuming this content. Reducing a dominant platform’s competitive advantage benefits users only if the platform prioritizes attracting rational users. Otherwise, intensifying competition can backfire by inducing this platform to exploit naive users. Awareness initiatives complement competition policy by making exploitation less attractive, but may increase market concentration.
abstract_zh: 加剧竞争能否保护社交媒体用户？答案取决于用户对社交媒体内容危害的认知程度。我们构建了一个存在天真用户的平台间非对称竞争模型，其中平台自主选择对有害但具吸引力的内容的放大程度。天真用户并未内化消费此类内容带来的负面影响。只有当占据主导地位的平台优先考虑吸引理性用户时，削弱其竞争优势才能惠及用户。否则，加剧竞争可能适得其反，促使该平台利用天真用户。认知提升举措通过降低剥削行为的吸引力来补充竞争政策，但可能导致市场集中度上升。

title: The Role of Inflation Perceptions in Consumer Inflation Expectations: Evidence from the Euro Area
authors: Matthieu Bussière, Johanna Gilbert, Olesya Grishchenko
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using data on euro-area household inflation forecasts from the European Commission Consumer Survey, we show that households' perceptions of recent price changes play a key role in the formation of their inflation expectations. Such a relationship remains robust when we account for specific inflation components, household characteristics, and macroeconomic conditions, even though the perceptions-expectations relationship is heterogeneous across countries. These results highlight the importance of perceptions about inflation for the conduct of monetary policy.
